title: PROOF-Gen: From Optimized Data to Better Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2608.23911v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated trajectories is the standard first stage for distilling tool-calling capabilities into deployable models. Post-training pipelines that drive shipped tool-calling agents re-run this stage on a daily or weekly cadence, paying the frontier-teacher cost each cycle, yet the mechanism is generate-and-filter (keep the teacher's passing trajectories, discard the rest) and each cycle leaves behind the same hard scenarios because failures supply no signal. On {\tau}2-bench, 57% of teacher trials fail, two-thirds of them near-misses (most tool calls correct, undone by one decisive error).   We introduce PROOF-Gen (Per-scenario Reflective Optimization to Overcome FailedGeneration), which recovers golden trajectories from these failures via per-scenario prompt optimization. translated_title: PROOF-Gen：从优化数据到更好的蒸馏
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23911v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在教师生成的轨迹上进行监督微调是将工具调用能力蒸馏到可部署模型中的标准第一阶段。推动已发布工具调用代理的后训练流水线以每日或每周的频率重新运行此阶段，每次循环都支付前沿教师成本，但其机制是生成并筛选（保留教师通过的轨迹，丢弃其余部分），且每次循环都会留下相同的困难场景，因为失败不提供任何信号。在τ2基准上，57%的教师试验失败，其中三分之二是接近成功（大部分工具调用正确，但被一个决定性错误破坏）。我们引入了PROOF-Gen（基于场景的反思性优化以克服失败生成），该方法通过逐场景提示优化从这些失败中恢复黄金轨迹。对于每个失败的任务，一个反思器分析执行轨迹和评估反馈，然后编写纠正性指导，以引导模型生成正确的轨迹。
tldr: 本文提出PROOF-Gen方法，通过反思器分析失败轨迹并生成纠正性提示优化，从教师模型的失败中恢复黄金轨迹，从而提升工具调用模型的蒸馏效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PROOF-Gen, which recovers golden trajectories from teacher failures via per-scenario reflective prompt optimization, enhancing distillation efficiency for tool-calling models.
